plain_statement: It is false that: There are constants c and k such that for every graph with every degree 0 or at least 3 and no cycle shorter than 5 and every least circuit of AND and OR gates (at most two inputs a gate) for its edge function: any set of edges, each of whose owning AND gates is true at one of the edge's ends alone or is true at c + 3 non-adjacent pairs that are disjoint apart from the edge's ends, has at most k(gates + 1) edges.
